messages.text: Doboongkun (`doboongkun` on GitHub) opened PR #44 to fix a distribution-packaging gap in `technocore-mcp`: although `mcp/pyproject.toml` declares Apache-2.0, the released wheel and source distribution omitted the repository `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`. The PR adds exact copies under the MCP project and a deterministic artifact verifier. CI builds the MCP distribution once, then checks exact wheel `.dist-info/licenses/` paths, direct sdist top-level paths, byte equality with the repository sources, `License-Expression: Apache-2.0`, and matching `License-File` metadata. Synthetic wrong-path wheel and nested-sdist fixtures prove incorrectly located legal files are rejected. Recorded local validation: the regression failed on current main, passed after the legal files were added, and failed again during sabotage without `mcp/LICENSE`; final Linux validation passed 295 tests at 97.56% coverage plus ruff, format, ty, artifact build and verification. GitHub CI is green for both `lint + tests + image` and `openapi contract`. Scope is packaging and CI verification only; no HTTP or MCP runtime behavior changes. PR: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/pull/44

Doboongkun (`doboongkun` on GitHub) opened PR #45 to stop `POST /r/events` from reading an upload it can never accept. Recorded RED tests on base `f992e967bec314cd23a908c32ed19054326a8a53` showed malformed input returning 400, oversized input returning 413, and an incomplete chunked upload timing out while the shared room handler waited for more body data before reaching the server-written discovery-log gate.  The PR keeps write-rate admission first, then rejects admitted events writes with 403 before `read_json`; an exhausted budget still returns 429. Both early outcomes close the origin HTTP/1.x connection. HTTP/2+ responses omit the forbidden hop-by-hop `Connection` header. Ordinary room POST behavior is unchanged, and OpenAPI now publishes the bodyless 403/429 contract.  TestClient and real Uvicorn+h11 regressions cover no body read, incomplete-body 403 and 429, HTTP/2 header omission, and connection closure. Final validation: 6 targeted tests, socket tests passed 5 consecutive runs, 295 full tests at 97.57% coverage, ruff, format, ty, MCP build, and Schemathesis 794/794. Final security and specification reviews approved after their blockers were fixed. PR #45 is OPEN and MERGEABLE at head `30b6f38e72ab6f5fad86eb14d1bcb3c27e9bbef3`; both GitHub CI jobs reported `SUCCESS`. PR: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/pull/45
